title: Reverse Integer
keyIdea: Pop digits off the end with x % 10 and push them onto sum with sum * 10 + digit. Before pushing, if |sum| > INT_MAX / 10, the × 10 would overflow, so return 0. % keeps x's sign, so negatives work on their own.

approaches.name: Pop and push digits
approaches.idea: Your logic (first written in Java): while x != 0, return 0 if |sum| > INT_MAX / 10; sum = sum * 10 + x % 10; x /= 10.
approaches.why: One step per decimal digit (at most 10); two ints.

options: If it is bigger, sum * 10 is past INT_MAX, which is an overflow
